open_points.subject: pre-export correction of imported room names
open_points.text: So the owner, before making the export on the VPS (R0-72), corrects there every room name of the projects to be picked that breaks this rule (owner, 2026-11-23, State 0 round-59 T1).
open_points.question: How can the owner correct an existing VPS room name when R0-10 says a room is never renamed or removed, and A16 imports the name the v1 instance gave it?
options: Create an explicit one-time exception allowing the owner to rename rooms in the VPS source before export.
Have the migration script replace room names in the export, and revise the claim that the import preserves the names the v1 instance gave them.
Exclude every project containing a nonconforming room name from the import.
Import the original name despite the writer rule.
open_points.default_guess: Add a narrowly scoped, owner-only pre-export migration exception that permits correcting room names in the legacy VPS source.

witness.initial: A picked VPS project has an existing room named "Bathroom for María's wheelchair", which breaks R0-96's writer rule.
events: The owner prepares the project for the one-time export.
R0-96 requires the owner to correct the room name on the VPS before making the export.
R0-10 requires that the existing room never be renamed or removed, while A16 imports it under its v1 name.
outcomes: Following R0-96, the owner renames the room and the import stores the corrected name.
Following R0-10 and A16, the room cannot be renamed and the import stores its original name, or the project cannot be prepared for import.
witness.observer: The owner sees whether the project can be imported, and the agent later sees either the corrected or original room name.
